name: KFA
description: K'UHUL Fold Algebra: the composition law of typed state transitions. A fold is F_phi : S -> S; the cycle is F_Xul . F_Ch'en . F_Sek . F_Yax . F_Wo . F_Pop, rightmost executing first. KFA decides structural composability; XCFE decides admission; Ch'en decides verification; Xul decides commit.

boundary.note: KFA owns neither topology (Fold Graph B), nor lifecycle state (Fold Lattice / Fold Kernel), nor admission (XCFE), nor execution. It owns one thing: whether two typed state transitions, or a sequence of them, may legally compose.

composition.notation: compose(after, before) = after . before; `before` executes first
laws: C1 associativity holds unconditionally: composition of total functions is associative, (F.G).H = F.(G.H)
C2 FOLD_IDENTITY is the two-sided unit: F.I = I.F = F
C3 composition is NOT commutative: F.G != G.F in general, because the phases and the operand types are ordered
C4 a collection of state transitions under composition is a monoid, not a K-algebra: there is no addition, no scalar multiplication and no bilinear product on transitions
C5 End_K(V) is an associative unital algebra, but K'UHUL execution folds include branching, gating, verification and memory effects, so they are not linear transformations
C6 composability is pairwise-local: a plan is admissible exactly when every adjacent pair is, which is why regrouping the pairs cannot change the answer

types.runtime_input: whatever entered the fold: text, candidate payload, or a substrate handle
types.bound_context: bindings and constraints established over the features (Wo)
types.collapsed_candidate: the single survivor named by a total-order reduction (COLLAPSE)
types.verified_outcome: the Ch'en gate token; the only value that unlocks TRAIN
types.weight_delta: a proposed W_learned delta; it is not the commit
types.folded_value: the single value a REDUCE produces

phases.description: Project the incoming payload onto the features the cycle will reason about. Pop is where memory is read; it establishes no bindings.
Establish bindings and constraints. Wo changes what the features mean, not which features exist. No SRAI operator is bound here yet; the fold is structural.
Generate candidate possibilities. Expansion is where the search space grows; nothing is admitted and nothing is committed.
Evaluate and admit legal candidates. Sek proposes; a high score promotes nothing by itself, because XCFE legality is a separate hard gate.
Measure evidence and confidence. Ch'en proves; the verified_outcome token it produces is the only value that unlocks TRAIN.
Produce output and authorize commitment. Xul commits; it is the only impure fold in the canonical cycle, and it is the only one whose effects propose a delta.

inner_operators.description: I(S) = S. The unit of the composition monoid and the only wildcard fold: its carrier is '*', so it composes with every fold and is elided from every execution order. A typed identity (IDENTITY_STATE, IDENTITY_TRANSFORM) is a stronger claim and elides only where its carrier chains.
Map_f(X) = { f(x) | x in X }. Cardinality is preserved, so a map inside a phase cannot admit or discard a candidate.
Filter_P(X) = { x in X | P(x) }. Cardinality may only shrink; the predicate is XCFE legality, so filtering is where admission happens inside a phase.
Reduce_(+,e)(X). A reduce carries no algebra of its own: its associativity, identity and regrouping licence come from the specific reducer's Algebraic Operator ISA contract.

operator_folds.description: TRAIN composes with anything whose output type it accepts, but it only composes LEGALLY when the value flowing in is a verified_outcome. That is the structural form of the rule that raw rank alone does not authorize learning.
The typed unit on FoldState. It is an identity, not a transition: eliding it is always sound, and using it to move the phase never is.
The typed unit on substrate transformations.
Not an identity. It carries phase authority, so it is impure even though its carrier is unchanged: the state is the same kind of thing, the control position is not.

canonical_plans.description: The six-fold K'UHUL cycle. Structurally legal; five phase crossings, each of which XCFE must still admit.
The SRAI dispatch pipeline. Legal end to end, because VERIFY stands between RANK and TRAIN.
Sek(C) = Rank(Filter_XCFE(Map_WCR(C))). Inner operators are phase-agnostic, so they impose no ordering and cross no boundary.
TRAIN fed straight from SCORE. The types chain, so this is exactly the case where only the verification rule saves it.
A plan that would run Xul before Sek traverses the cycle backwards.

invariants: K1 a fold is a typed state transition F_phi : S -> S; composition is the only combinator
K2 a composition is structurally legal only when the earlier fold's output_type is among the later fold's input_types
K3 a plan traverses the cycle at most once and only forwards; a second traversal is a new plan, not a longer composition
K4 a phase crossing is plannable but not authorized: requires_admission is true and XCFE owns the decision
K5 a fold declaring requires_verification composes legally only downstream of a verified_outcome
K6 FOLD_IDENTITY is the two-sided unit and is elided from the execution order; a typed identity elides only where its types chain
K7 composition is associative unconditionally, because composition of total functions is associative
K8 composition is not commutative; operand order is the execution order
K9 a monoid of transitions is not an algebra over a field: no addition, no scalar multiplication, no bilinear product on folds
K10 composability is pairwise-local, so a plan is admissible exactly when every adjacent pair is
K11 the rewrite licence of a plan is the intersection of its members' licences: a composition is not more algebraic than its weakest stage
K12 KFA decides composition, XCFE decides admission, Ch'en decides verification, Xul decides commit; no layer may answer for another
K13 every SRAI operator resolves to exactly one KFA fold whose phase, effects and algebra_ref match the SRAI and AOI registries
K14 the phase fold's operator set is exactly the SRAI operators declared at that phase; an operator may not appear in two phases
